rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when “utter” means total or complete, as in utter darkness or utter ruin.

example.english: After the power cut, the whole room was in utter darkness.
example.traditional: 停電之後，成間屋完全黑晒。
example.jyutping: ting4 din6 zi1 hau6 seng4 gaan1 uk1 jyun4 cyun4 hak1 saai3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for producing a vocal sound, including telling someone not to say another word.

example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 ceot1 seng1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when the utterance specifically puts words or content into speech, rather than merely making a vocal sound.

example.english: I finally utter the words I had always been afraid to say.
example.traditional: 我終於講出一直唔敢講嗰句說話喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 gong2 ceot1 jat1 zik6 m4 gam2 gong2 go2 geoi3 syut3 waa6 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a decision or reply that is firm, definite, and leaves no room for qualification.

example.english: When the manager asked whether they would work overtime, they gave an utter refusal: “No, that’s not negotiable.”
example.traditional: 經理問佢肯唔肯加班，佢斬釘截鐵咁話：「唔肯，冇得傾。」
example.jyutping: ging1 lei5 man6 keoi5 hang2 m4 hang2 gaa1 baan1 keoi5 zaam2 deng1 zit6 tit3 gam3 waa6 m4 hang2 mou5 dak1 king1

rows.note: Use this when a machine, animal, or other thing emits a noise rather than when a person says words.

example.english: The machine suddenly began to utter a sound, which startled us.
example.traditional: 部機突然發出聲音，嚇親我哋。
example.jyutping: bou6 gei1 dat6 jin4 faat3 ceot1 seng1 jam1 haak3 can1 ngo5 dei6
